title: Two kinds of journey
hook: Movements can repeat on different timescales.

knows: Animals can respond to cues and conditions.
doesNotKnow: A toy animal moves between feeding and resting places each day; another shifts region each season. Which journey is seasonal?

misconception: The stated evidence implies a different interpretation or a universal conclusion.
objective: A toy animal moves between feeding and resting places each day; another shifts region each season. Which journey is seasonal?

claims.text: A toy animal moves between feeding and resting places each day; another shifts region each season. Which journey is seasonal? The first panel shows a return between feeding and resting places within a day. The second shows a regional move between seasons. The scenarios illustrate the distinction; no real route or migration schedule is implied.

claims.text: The panels show a stipulated illustrative model and do not depict observed data.

One bird flies to a local roost each evening; another shifts regions between seasons. Which is the seasonal movement? A seasonal regional shift occurs on a different timescale from a daily roost trip.
